name: Ciroc Summer Citrus Vodka
flavour_style: blood orange tangerine lime zest lemon
description: A limited-edition Summer Citrus vodka from Ciroc that has aromas of blood orange and tangerine on the nose, complemented by notes of lime zest, blood orange and lemon throughout the palate.

name: Grey Goose Vodka
description: The iconic ultra-premium vodka, Grey Goose is a staple in bars and restaurants around the world. Born of a determination to create a French vodka unlike any other, it is made with the finest ingredients from the Cognac region of France. Delicate and fresh, with a creamy texture, Grey Goose is perfect for making your favourite cocktails, or simply enjoying over ice.

name: Belvedere Organic Vodka
description: A bottle of glorious quadruple-distilled rye vodka of extraordinary purity, Belvedere is as well known for its beautiful bottle as for its quality. A style-bar favourite.

name: Reyka Vodka
description: Reyka is a small batch vodka produced in Iceland using a process that includes the filtration through lava rock.  Made in one of only six carter head stills in the world, this is made from a mixture of wheat and barley.

name: Svitlo Vodka of Ukraine Litre
description: A creamy, well-balanced corn vodka from the Cherasky region of central Ukraine. This is a great choice for your next Martini or Bloody Mary, but it will also really shine served well-chilled with pickles and smoke meat or fish. Every bottle of Svitlo sold helps to support creative industries in Ukraine, a cause well worth raising a glass to.

name: Utkins UK5 Organic Vodka
description: Utkins UK5 organic vodka is made using organic barley and pure British water to create a crisp and great tasting spirit. The producers have held a royal warrant since 2007, appointed by King Charles while he was Prince of Wales, and continued now that he is king.

name: Black Cow Vodka
description: Black Cow was the world's first vodka to be made entirely from milk. Made in West Dorset, in the proximity of Bridport, the milk is separated in curds and whey. The curds are used to make cheese, of which one is Barber's 1833 Cheddar, which won the 2012 World Cheese Awards Cheddar Trophy. The whey is then fermented and distilled to make the vodka. The texture is, somewhat unsurprisingly, rather creamy.

name: Pau Maui Vodka
description: This crisp vodka is made at Hali’imaile distillery in Makawao, Hawaii. In addition to producing vodka, the distillery also makes gin, rum and whiskey. Pau Maui vodka is designed to work well in an array of classic cocktails but shines when mixed with juicy pineapples – the original Hawaiian treat.

name: Beluga Noble Vodka
description: A bottle of Beluga's excellent vodka, distilled in Latvia and bottled in Montenegro. Clean and crisp with just a hint of grainy flavour.  Made with malted barley as a base, this is lightly flavoured with honey, oak and milk thistle.

name: Konik's Tail Vodka
description: Launched in 2010, Konik's Tail is named after the wild ponies of Poland's primeval forest, and is crafted from three distinct grains – spelt, rye and early winter wheat, represented by the three koniks on the label. Konik's Tail has been a huge hit in style bars.

name: Zubrowka Biala Winter Rye
description: The non-flavoured version of famous Polish brand Zubrowka, made from winter rye. With the classic creamy texture, this will work well chilled on its own or in a variety of mixed drinks.

name: Chopin Potato Vodka
description: A superb-quality Polish potato vodka, distilled four times – it takes approximately five kilos of potatoes to make each bottle.  Chopin is a long-time favourite in style bars and has an enviable reputation as one of the finest vodkas available.

name: Zubrowka Bisongrass Vodka
description: Zubrowka is one of the best Polish vodkas available, flavoured with a special kind of aromatic bisongrass that is so prized that it costs £400 per kilo. Long renowned for its luxurious flavours and stellar quality, Zubrowka is simply outstanding with apple juice, especially the posh cloudy stuff.

name: Crystal Head Aurora Vodka
description: A 2015 limited-edition extension to Dan Aykroyd's Crystal Head range, this is named after the natural light phenomenon, Aurora Borealis. Made with English wheat and Canadian water, this is five-times distilled and seven-times filtered. Drier, bolder and spicier than the original.

name: Kavka Vodka
description: A classically-styled Polish vodka, made in the west of the country in a distillery that has been making spirit for more than 200 years. Master distiller Urzula Wojcik has turned back the clock to the 18th and 19th century and used plum and apple in addition to rye and wheat to create a vodka with real character and, unlike many, taste. It's a crisp and clean vodka, but with gentle fruitiness – excellent in a Martini.

name: Smirnoff Black Label Vodka
description: This premium variant of Smirnoff is pot-distilled and filtered through seven tons of charcoal in a painstaking production process designed to produce a vodka of rare purity.

name: Potocki Vodka
description: A terrific rye vodka, distilled just twice and bottled without charcoal filtration to retain its full-flavoured nuttiness.  Potocki is one of the best Polish vodkas on the market.

name: Ammos Aegean Vodka
flavour_style: bright citrus notes subtle saline depth layered refreshing character
description: Premium Greek-inspired craft vodka infused with the essence of the Aegean. Bright citrus notes from Vakhalou lemons meet a subtle saline depth from dry-cured olives, creating a layered, refreshing character. Cold-distilled to preserve its delicate flavours, it’s perfect neat, chilled, or in elevated cocktails.

name: Belvedere Vodka Gift Box
description: Belvedere is a glorious quadruple-distilled rye vodka of extraordinary purity, well known for its beautiful bottle as for its quality. As always with vodka, this is all about its character, rather than its flavour, and makes a great base for a Vodka Martini or Vesper. This favourite of cocktail bars, nightclubs and home drinks cabinets alike comes beautifully packaged in a great gift box.

name: Tito's Vodka
description: Tito's Vodka hails from Texas' first and oldest legal distillery in Austin.  The brainchild of former geologist Tito Beveridge, this is six times distilled.

name: Jewel Lines Precious Vodka Sapphire
description: Jewel Lines' Precious Vodka is distilled six times in Bulgaria. Each bottle includes a real sapphire and would make an extra-luxurious gift.

name: Wyborowa Vodka
description: This is a popular rye-based vodka from Poland with history dating back to 1927. This works brilliantly in classic cocktails and helps other flavours shine whilst adding a creamy texture and subtle spice.

name: Bimber Blackcurrant Infused Vodka
flavour_style: warming fruity vodka with notes of honey, clove, cinnamon and vanilla
description: Made in west London, this is a blend of quadruple-distilled wheat vodka and real blackcurrants – half a kilo per bottle. A warming fruity vodka with notes of honey, clove, cinnamon and vanilla.

name: Ciroc Limonata Vodka
description: Ciroc produces a wonderful range of flavoured vodkas which includes this Limonata Vodka. Made from an infusion of citrus and Italian lemon flavours, this is a zesty and zippy vodka, perfect in a spritz or Cosmopolitan.
